title: User registration accepts an absent email
symptoms: Missing required registration fields reached persistence and produced a 500 instead of a validation response.
root_cause: The registration handler read optional JSON fields without validating email before insertion.
resolution: Validate name and email before persistence and return a 400 with a safe field error.
runbook: Verify invalid input is rejected and valid registration succeeds

title: Null user profile dereference
symptoms: Profile lookup intermittently returned 500 for accounts without an optional profile.
root_cause: The profile repository legitimately returned null, but the response mapper assumed an object.
resolution: Handle missing profiles explicitly with defaults and test newly registered accounts.
runbook: Create an account without profile metadata
Test both missing and populated profiles

title: User database connection refused
symptoms: User reads failed with 503 while the health process remained alive.
root_cause: The user database hostname pointed to an unavailable development database after a configuration edit.
resolution: Restore the database address and validate connection configuration before accepting requests.
runbook: Inspect configured host without printing credentials
Restore endpoint and verify user lookup

title: Authentication signing key mismatch
symptoms: Previously valid sessions consistently failed verification immediately after a local key rotation.
root_cause: One user-service process kept the previous signing key while other processes issued tokens with the new key.
resolution: Deploy consistent verification keys and support a bounded overlap during rotation.
runbook: Test old and new sessions during overlap

title: User dependency timeout during registration
symptoms: Registration became slow and then failed when the profile enrichment endpoint did not respond.
root_cause: An optional enrichment call had no independent timeout and delayed core registration.
resolution: Set a deadline and degrade optional enrichment without losing the user creation result.

title: Invalid authentication issuer configuration
symptoms: All authentication attempts were rejected after restarting with an incomplete issuer setting.
error_message: AUTH_ISSUER must be a nonempty URL
root_cause: Startup configuration validation accepted an empty issuer and the verifier rejected every session later.
resolution: Validate authentication issuer at startup and restore the expected trusted issuer.
runbook: Test a valid issuer and a wrong issuer

title: Slow user lookup from missing query index
symptoms: User lookup latency rose as a local fixture dataset grew, while CPU and database access stayed available.
root_cause: A normalized-email equality lookup scanned the user table because the expected unique index was absent.
resolution: Add the email lookup index after checking duplicates and verify the query plan.
runbook: Inspect query plan and duplicate emails
Create the correct index and compare latency
code_context: SELECT id FROM users WHERE normalized_email = ?;

title: Unbounded user response cache causes heap pressure
symptoms: The process consumed increasing memory during repeated distinct user lookups and eventually returned 500.
error_message: JavaScript heap limit reached in user cache
root_cause: A response cache had no entry limit or expiry, so distinct user IDs retained objects indefinitely.
resolution: Bound cache entries and TTL, evict expired objects, and test memory under a fixed request budget.
runbook: Run a bounded load test and check recovery
code_context: cache.set(userId, response); // requires size and TTL limits

title: Order amount missing from request
symptoms: Submitting an order without an amount returned a server error and created inconsistent downstream requests.
root_cause: Order creation delegated to the payment adapter before validating integer monetary input.
resolution: Validate positive integer cents before writing an order or contacting payment.
runbook: Confirm invalid orders have no side effects

title: Undefined cart item causes checkout crash
symptoms: Checkout returned 500 for an empty cart while nonempty carts worked.
root_cause: Checkout accessed items[0] before checking that the cart contained a line item.
resolution: Reject empty carts and validate every line item before calculating totals.
runbook: Reproduce with an empty items array
Validate cart length and line shapes
Test empty, malformed and valid carts

title: Order database pool exhausted
symptoms: Concurrent order requests timed out waiting for connections although the database server was reachable.
error_message: Timed out acquiring order database connection
root_cause: An exception path omitted transaction cleanup and leaked checked-out database connections.
resolution: Always close transactions in a finally block and right-size bounded connection pooling.
code_context: try { await tx.createOrder(); } finally { await tx.close(); }

title: User service unavailable during order validation
symptoms: Order creation returned 503 because required user lookups could not connect to the user service.
root_cause: The configured user-service URL used localhost inside an order container, which addressed that container itself.
resolution: Use the configured service DNS name on the container network, or the host loopback address for direct Node runs.
runbook: Retry user validation with a known user

title: Repeated checkout 500 after faulty commit
symptoms: Every order request returned 500 immediately after a change to the repository return value.
error_message: Cannot destructure order id from undefined
root_cause: A faulty commit removed the return statement from createOrder, while the controller still expected an order object.
resolution: Restore the return contract and add an integration test for the controller and repository.
runbook: Run order creation and retrieval tests

title: Order queue accumulates during slow payment dependency
symptoms: Checkout latency increased and in-flight requests grew when payment processing slowed.
root_cause: Order handling kept starting payment calls without concurrency limits or a deadline during downstream slowdown.
resolution: Apply bounded concurrency and abortable payment deadlines; return a controlled dependency error.
runbook: Verify recovery when payment latency returns to normal

title: Order status configuration invalid
symptoms: Order creation failed at startup after an unsupported initial status was configured.
error_message: INITIAL_ORDER_STATUS is not an allowed value
root_cause: A development environment override introduced a status outside the schema enum.
resolution: Validate enum configuration at startup and restore the supported CREATED initial state.
runbook: Compare status enum with environment setting
Create and retrieve a test order

title: Oversized cart exhausts request resources
symptoms: A very large cart caused excessive parsing and pricing work before the API rejected it.
error_message: Order cart exceeds the allowed item count
root_cause: The order API limited bytes weakly and did not cap line-item count, permitting expensive request work.
resolution: Bound request body size and cart item count before pricing and reject oversized requests with 413.
runbook: Apply byte and item count limits

title: Payment amount absent from JSON request
symptoms: Payment processing returned a controlled validation error when the caller omitted the amount.
root_cause: The caller sent an order identifier but omitted the required integer-cent payment amount.
resolution: Keep validation at the payment boundary and correct the caller payload before retrying.
runbook: Inspect the request shape without logging secrets
Test missing, zero, fractional and valid amounts

title: Null payment provider result dereferenced
symptoms: Payments returned 500 when the provider returned no transaction object.
root_cause: A provider adapter returned null for a rejected authorization, but the handler treated every result as successful.
resolution: Validate provider response shape and map rejection to a controlled payment failure.
runbook: Verify rejection does not mark payment processed

title: Payment ledger database connection failure
symptoms: Payment status writes failed with 503 after the ledger database became unreachable.
root_cause: The ledger connection address changed without updating the payment-service connection configuration.
resolution: Restore ledger connectivity, verify configuration, and reconcile pending records before retrying charges.
runbook: Reconcile status before retrying to avoid double charges

title: Fee subtraction introduced payment total regression
symptoms: Payment totals were below the base amount after a small arithmetic change.
root_cause: A faulty revision subtracted the rounded two-percent processing fee instead of adding it.
resolution: Restore integer-cent fee addition and test fixed totals, rounding boundaries and the total invariant.
runbook: Test rounding and fee invariant before release

title: Payment provider deadline exceeded
symptoms: Payment requests waited for a stalled upstream processor and returned a controlled timeout.
root_cause: The remote payment processor stopped responding within the allowed request budget.
resolution: Abort the upstream request at the deadline and reconcile provider status before a bounded retry.
runbook: Verify abort at the configured deadline

title: Invalid payment fee configuration
symptoms: All payment attempts failed fee validation after a nonnumeric rate was configured.
root_cause: An environment override set the fee rate to text, which propagated into arithmetic as NaN.
resolution: Validate finite numeric rates at startup, restore the rate, and verify expected integer totals.
runbook: Verify total for a known integer amount

title: Payment processor repeatedly rejects authorization
symptoms: Repeated payment attempts returned a controlled upstream rejection while the local process remained healthy.
root_cause: The simulated upstream provider rejected the authorization; successful transport did not imply a successful payment.
resolution: Inspect the provider rejection, preserve failed status, and retry only when the rejection condition is corrected.
runbook: Verify recovery with an accepted authorization

title: Duplicate charge protection dependency unavailable
symptoms: Payment retries were blocked when the idempotency store could not be reached.
error_message: Idempotency store unavailable; charge not submitted
root_cause: The idempotency backend was unavailable, so proceeding could have submitted duplicate charges.
resolution: Fail closed before charging, restore the idempotency store, and reuse the original operation key.
runbook: Retry with the same operation identifier
